Author: Panda
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description: Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try! Needs AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json) and works best with Allagan Tools. Optional: FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf) and Submarine Tracker. Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team, Critical_Impact, erdelf and Infi for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
No database change needed. Works with any app version; moving the database needs app 0.35.0 or newer on the PC it moves to.

- Follows the database when it moves to another PC (the app's Settings → Database → Move the database to this PC). At its next sync it finds the new address the app left in the old database, connects to it with the same database name, username and password, and saves it in its settings. If this PC can't reach the new address, the log says so once and nothing is synced until it can; it tries again at every sync.
- While the app is copying the database, the plugin waits instead of syncing, and tries again every minute. If the app is closed mid-move, the plugin carries on as usual after 5 minutes.
- Each PC's status now includes the database login the plugin uses, so a move can check every PC will be let in.
- The plugin's database connections are named "XIV Fleet Companion plugin", so the app can tell when a sync is still running.
